job.title: Data Center Network Operations Engineer
job.location: Atlanta, Austin, Denver, NYC, SF, Seattle or DC
job.pay_full: Estimated base salary by location: San Francisco $126,000 – $174,000; Seattle, Washington D.C. and New York $120,000 – $165,000; Austin, Denver and Atlanta $98,000 – $123,000 a year; eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan

details.about: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, protecting and accelerating millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers from individual bloggers to Fortune 500 companies. This role focuses on maintaining Cloudflare's global network, working closely with its SRE, Network Engineering and Network Deployment Engineering teams and with hardware vendors, data center and network providers and ISPs, and on developing consistent processes and visibility measures for managing the infrastructure. It calls for a deep understanding of data center infrastructure and physical networking, plus basic data analysis and project management.
duties: Work with Infrastructure, Network Engineering and SRE teams; create documentation and manage remote contractors to complete data center tasks with hardware makers, data center and network providers and logistics partners, supporting 330+ cities in 125+ countries
Use AI tools to automate repetitive operational tasks, speed up documentation and accelerate troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
Create and maintain documentation, plans, SOPs and MOPs
Support and configure network infrastructure where required
Give feedback to internal teams on internal tools and vendor partnerships
May also include: introducing new technology and automation, defining consistent processes across regions, and limited travel
needs: Experience with Juniper, Cisco and DWDM network equipment
At least 4 years of Linux systems administration
Experience managing and instructing remote contractors
Familiarity with standing up infrastructure in remote colocation facilities
Experience running and improving operational processes, including automation tooling, in a fast-changing environment
Familiarity with day-to-day data center operations work (deployment, migration, decommissioning)
Comfortable with basic program management (prioritization, planning, scheduling, status reporting), e.g. in JIRA
Take part in a shared on-call rotation for 24×7 availability of the global network
nice: Bachelor's degree with a technical background in engineering, computer science or MIS
Experience with complex data center or infrastructure projects and DCIM tools
Multi-lingual; experience with infrastructure in multiple countries
Comfort with remote "lights-out" and out-of-band access to data center resources
Linux certifications (e.g. RHCSA) or network certifications (CCNA, JNCIA or higher)
Configuration management such as Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible
Scripting or software development in Bash, Python or Go
Familiarity with load balancers and reverse proxies such as Nginx, Varnish, HAProxy or Apache
Experience at a large-scale SaaS vendor
details.benefits: Estimated base salary depends on location and level: San Francisco $126,000 – $174,000; Seattle, Washington D.C. and New York $120,000 – $165,000; Austin, Denver and Atlanta $98,000 – $123,000. The role is eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan.
notes: Hybrid role; hiring locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington, DC
Applicants who reach the offer stage may be asked to attend an in-person interview at a Cloudflare office or hub
The position may require access to information protected under US export control laws
